$comment: Golden oracle for round-robin standings + tie-break resolution (FR-052, FR-057, FR-090, FR-095, BR-109, NFR-018). Tie-breakers are an ORDERED list applied only among currently-tied participants until the tie resolves; the final fallback MUST be deterministic given a stored rng_seed.
invariants: standings points are computed from results via score(result, config) per participant
tie-breakers apply ONLY within the set of participants tied on the prior criterion
headToHead builds a mini-table using ONLY matches among the tied participants
pointsScored = sum of a participant's own scores across ALL their matches
'random' is the last resort and MUST be reproducible from the stored rng_seed (NFR-018)
final ranks are dense and total-ordered (no unresolved ties after the ordered list is exhausted)

cases.name: 3-way tie on points; headToHead is a cycle (unresolved) -> pointsScored resolves

resolution.$comment: Mini-table among A,B,C only: A beat B, B beat C, C beat A -> each 1 win / 1 loss = 3 pts. Cycle: UNRESOLVED.
Sum of each participant's own scores across all matches.

cases.name: 2-way tie resolved directly by headToHead
cases.$comment: No tie among E/F/G on points here; included as the simple case where, when two players ARE level on points, the head-to-head result between them alone decides (the winner ranks above).

randomFallback.$comment: When ALL configured tie-breakers before 'random' leave participants level, order is decided by a deterministic PRNG seeded with the tournament's stored rng_seed. The specific ordering is implementation-defined by the seed algorithm, but MUST be identical across repeated runs with the same seed (property test: determinism), and MUST be a strict total order (no residual ties).
